collections.subtitle: Up to 20% off headphones and earbuds

collections.title: The calm desk
collections.subtitle: Tools for deep work, built to last

products.name: Aero Buds Pro
products.description: True wireless earbuds with adaptive noise cancelling, a 30-hour case and a fit you forget about.

products.name: Halo Over-Ear
products.description: Studio-grade over-ear headphones with memory foam cushions and 40 hours of battery.

products.name: Pulse Mini Speaker
products.description: A palm-sized speaker that fills a room, floats in water and survives the beach.

products.name: Orbit Watch S2
products.description: A sapphire-glass smartwatch with seven-day battery, ECG and an always-on display.

products.name: Loop Fitness Band
products.description: A featherweight band that tracks sleep, strain and recovery without a screen.

products.name: Vista Smart Glasses
products.description: Open-ear audio and a camera in a frame that looks like ordinary glasses.

products.name: Nomad Daypack 22L
products.description: A weatherproof daypack with a padded laptop sleeve and a hidden passport pocket.

products.name: Transit Sling
products.description: A slim sling for phone, keys and wallet, with quick-access magnetic buckles.

products.name: Harbour Weekender
products.description: Carry-on sized duffel with a shoe compartment and a trolley sleeve.

products.name: Glow Desk Lamp
products.description: A dimmable lamp that shifts from cool to warm light and charges your phone.

products.name: Brew Pour-Over Kettle
products.description: Precision gooseneck kettle that holds temperature to the degree.

products.name: Aura Diffuser
products.description: An ultrasonic diffuser with a sunrise light and a whisper-quiet mist.

products.name: Cloud Knit Throw
products.description: A chunky knit throw made from recycled cotton, soft enough to steal from the sofa.

products.name: Flux Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: A low-profile wireless keyboard with hot-swappable switches and per-key light.

products.name: Glide Mouse
products.description: An ergonomic mouse with a silent click and a scroll wheel that spins forever.

products.name: Dock 9-in-1 Hub
products.description: One cable for two 4K displays, Ethernet, SD cards and 100 W pass-through charging.

products.name: Riser Laptop Stand
products.description: A foldable aluminium stand that raises your screen to eye level in one motion.

products.name: Charge 20K Power Bank
products.description: Charges a laptop, a phone and earbuds at once, and fits in a jacket pocket.
